trigger_queries.query: which gates do I need before committing this change to src/application/operations/pull.ts?
bun run test:sandbox finished, summary.md says 'duration regression vs baseline: +31%' on unit. is that a problem?
a test passes with bun test on my mac but the sandbox unit container says ENOENT /workspace/docs/foo.json
the tcp suite failed once in the sandbox but I can't reproduce it, how do I tell if it's contention?
I added one line to the changelog after the sandbox went green. do I have to run the whole thing again?
test:model printed seed 81723 path 4:2:1 size max and failed, replay it
I touched sdk/python/bunqueue/client.py, what do I run before handing off?
read artifacts/test-sandbox/2026-11-12T20-20-16.500Z and tell me the totals for the evidence
docker isn't running on this machine, can I just run bun test --parallel=4 instead of the sandbox?
run the Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04 OrbStack Machines for the release
measure push throughput before and after my change
fix the bug where cancel() leaves a job in the processing map
write a GitHub Actions workflow for my own app that runs bunqueue tests
how do I configure stall detection in a Worker?
start my session and tell me which work item is ready
publish the new version to npm
format the file I just wrote
trigger_queries.note: a single bun fmt call, no gate decision

evals.prompt: I changed src/domain/queue/shard.ts to fix FIFO group ordering. What do I run before committing, and in which order?
evals.expected_output: bun run test:model first (FIFO groups are on its trigger list), then bun run test:sandbox in the background on a frozen, staged tree recorded with git write-tree, plus typecheck, format:check and git diff --check; no SDK gate unless sdk/ changed; read summary.md KPIs and anomalies and report exact totals with the artifact path.
assertions: bun run test:model is required before the sandbox for this change
bun run test:sandbox is required, and nothing else is accepted in its place
The tree is staged and recorded with git write-tree before the gate starts
The report names per-suite totals, anomalies and the artifact directory

evals.prompt: Sandbox green on tree 386b8522. Since then I edited docs/agents/release.md and the changelog only. Can I commit without rerunning?
evals.expected_output: The agent runs gate-delta.sh --gated 386b8522, gets exit 3 (docs-only), reruns the focused tests it lists (agent-harness, agent-skills, docs tests, generate-release-posts --check, check:docs-data), and records both tree hashes in the evidence; it does not claim the old gate covers the new tree without that proof, and still requires the skeptic before a commit.
assertions: The delta is proven with gate-delta.sh or git diff --cached --stat against the gated hash
The docs-reading tests are rerun on the new tree
Both the gated and the current tree hash appear in the evidence
A code path in the delta would require rerunning bun run test:sandbox

evals.prompt: The unit suite failed in the sandbox: test/repro-chaos-soak.test.ts timed out, but it passes when I run it alone on my mac.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the complete unit.log and summary.md, reruns the gate with BUNQUEUE_TEST_SEQUENTIAL=1 to separate contention from a product bug, checks CPU and memory KPIs around the failure timestamp, and only classifies it as an application bug after a sequential or focused reproduction; a host pass is not accepted as evidence.
assertions: BUNQUEUE_TEST_SEQUENTIAL=1 is used to check for parallel-only contention
The host-only pass is treated as diagnostic, not as a gate result
A real bug is handed to the reproduce-first bug workflow
